OFF TRACK DOSSIER

When the Formula One visor goes up, the passion for motorsport never pauses. Explore Team Redline virtual endurance esports, the Verstappen.com Racing GT3 program, Falcon 8X private aviation, and high-intensity padel training.

VIRTUAL ENDURANCE MASTERY

Max competes regularly alongside elite sim drivers in 24-hour virtual endurance events, often logging 4-hour night stints in his bespoke home rig between F1 race weekends. Equipped with professional direct-drive wheelbases and pneumatic load-cell pedals replicating real F1 brake pressure.

SIM PLATFORM iRacing & rFactor 2
WHEELBASE Simucube 2 Ultimate (25Nm)
PEDAL RESISTANCE 130 kg Force Hydraulic
DISPLAYS Triple 32" 240Hz OLED

VERSTAPPEN.COM RACING GT3 PROGRAM

Spearheaded by Max to bridge the gap between virtual sim talents and real-world GT3 competition. Partnering with Emil Frey Racing, fielding state-of-the-art Ferrari 296 GT3 cars adorned in the iconic matte Red Bull livery across the legendary circuits of Europe.
